# HEZQEN Infrastructure Standard

> Provider-neutral engineering standards, schemas, templates, validation tooling, and independently versioned infrastructure kits for reproducible AI and infrastructure products.

## Start here

- [Repository overview](README.md): purpose, product portfolio, setup, and validation.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): tutorials, how-to guides, explanations, and references.
- [Engineering handbook](docs/engineering-handbook.md): normative language and engineering principles.
- [Product registry](products/README.md): current workspaces and evidence status.
- [Standards](standards/): normative architecture, security, quality, licensing, and operations requirements.
- [Schemas](schemas/): machine-readable product and artifact contracts.

## Important limitations

HIES is not a hosted service or a compliance certification. Product workspaces are engineering previews unless their release metadata explicitly states otherwise. A passing CI workflow proves only the checks it executes.
